sourceState: Phase 1 pagination commit plus benchmark fixtures in the working tree; DLL hashes are authoritative for the measured binaries.
method: Two independent processes; each warms all fixtures, calibrates batches to at least 20 ms, then records 32 alternating baseline/current rounds per workload. Both variants are methods in one build with byte-identical output.
allocationCounter: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true), process-wide; per-operation allocation excludes setup and sample bookkeeping.
limitations: Synthetic in-process handler construction and Stream.Null response writes, no network/database. Virtual host frequency and unrelated host activity are uncontrolled. Only this task builds/tests/servers are coordinated to stop before final measurement.
